digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate: budget cap override seam
propositions: shed_to_budget currently computes budget cap internally via plan_budget_cap(ctx) with no injection point for per-request overrides
REBAR_PLAN_REVIEW_BUDGET env var is centrality-scaled and cannot serve as a true cap override; ProductionBatchRunner.run receives req.usd_budget but cannot apply it
cap_override parameter must be threaded through ProductionBatchRunner.run → run_pass1 → shed_to_budget, used verbatim without centrality scaling, defaulting to None for backward compatibility
explicit cap_override=0.0 must be honourable as a real cap rather than treated as absent; selection uses 'is None' not falsy check
coverage["budget"] must record cap_source ('override' or 'computed') to remain observable which cap governed a run; runner journals budget_override_applied=True when override applied
